VBO:0201323.summary: Swiss mountain dogs, or Sennenhunde, comprise the Bernese, Greater Swiss, Appenzeller and Entlebucher breeds. Their Swiss farm histories include cattle work, guarding and, especially in the larger breeds, pulling carts.
VBO:0201323.shortDescription: The four Sennenhunde breeds share Swiss farm roots, with cattle, guarding and draught-working traditions.

sources.title: AKC — Get to Know the Sennenhunde Breeds
